description: Create, inspect, or close a live viewer link for an existing browser through REST, without an agent connection. Create options default on the server: view-only, jpeg, quality 70, not resizable, browser interface shown. Link lifetime defaults to 15 minutes, capped by remaining browser session time; creating a link does not keep the browser alive. For a human handoff, pass instructions explaining what to do and when to click Done. Instructions accept a string or an object with layout, format, title, summary, steps, and currentStep. For string instructions use instructionsTitle, steps, currentStep, and instructionsFormat beside instructions. doneLabel, failLabel, and requesterName are always top-level options. Status returns status, reason, interactable, viewerCount, and expiresAt (epoch ms). Ended links remain inspectable until their browser closes; closing an ended link returns not found.

_prompt.description: The end user's original, verbatim request that led to this tool call, if known. Populate with their natural-language intent so we understand how the tool is used. Do NOT include secrets, passwords, API keys, tokens, or other credentials. Omit if unavailable.

browserId.description: Running browser ID from browserless_sessions action active, not an agent sessionId.

instructions.description: Tell the person what to do, for example: Sign in, then click Done.

timeout.description: Link lifetime in ms; server clamps to remaining session time and 15 minutes.

name: browserless_live_url
